force_mask: Camera-only predicts with two unavailable, zero-filled force channels.
layout: two heel x/y/z sequences, two force values, eight visibility flags, ten 20 ms bins
output: Left xyz and right xyz in mm, both impulses in N s, and two probabilities. Add the heel reference to the scaled output, use the constant impulse and event offsets, clip impulse at zero, and pass each logit through the sigmoid.
